title: Taylor series converges throughout a holomorphic disc
statement: Let $h:\mathbf C\to\mathbf C$, $c\in\mathbf C$, and $R\in[0,\infty]$. Suppose $h$ is complex differentiable at every point of $D(c,R)=\{z:|z-c|<R\}$. The formal Taylor series $\sum_{n\ge0}\frac{h^{(n)}(c)}{n!}T^n\in\mathbf C[[T]]$ uses the formal-series convention of [d-real-series]. For every $z\in D(c,R)$, the series $\sum_{n\ge0}\frac{h^{(n)}(c)}{n!}(z-c)^n$ converges to $h(z)$ (as the sum of the family indexed by $\mathbf N$).
